I answered Pree in a thread reply on their message in #central-team: the store is **Pine Crossing**.

It comes from Pree's own message in #central-team on Jun 9. They said Pine Crossing's morning receiver reported that the appointment screen showed only the afternoon shift. Hollis said he'd check the shift template and get support to reproduce it with the store login.

I couldn't find a separate site code or address for Pine Crossing in the channels or public files Pree can see. My reply says so and suggests they check the rollout tracker or ask store ops if the account sheet needs one.
